rules.merge: same dish in multiple sources = one canonical class; merges are explicit in build_taxonomy.ALIASES + this file's merge_note fields
rules.floor_R1: drop canonical classes with verified total < 80 images (dropped: 0; smallest kept verified class is marble cake, 83)
rules.no_further_trim_R2: per-class counts are near-uniform in every source, so higher thresholds delete major dishes; balance is enforced by the prep-time per-class cap instead
rules.cap: data_prep_v2 caps each class at MAX_PER_CLASS=400 images after dedupe
rules.region: indian = Indian-subcontinent dish identity (all Khana classes except its world items, the v1 Indian sets, chicken curry); world = everything else
